mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.7% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in >60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial output) signal robust demand growth, amplifying corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than when proxies move independently.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates signal higher interest costs for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative <50% of the time during tightening periods, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 110 signals weakening supply-side growth, reducing corporate profit margins and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative in >70% of triggered instances, or IC rank >0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous spikes in UNRATE above 4.7% and PAYEMS exceeding 140,000 indicate labor market tightness, raising wage inflation expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month window, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both proxies trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (total demand) over the past month predicts stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive in >80% of instances where GDPC1 trend is upward, or IC rank <0.03 over any 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising INDPRO above 114 signals peak supply growth, leading to overvaluation concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain negative <50% of the time during late-cycle expansions, or IC rank >0.03 over any 18-month window.
